LanguageData.RHA_StarTwin030_Linked: Cores linked — damage to one charges the other.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTwin030_Brief: The two cores protect each other within link range, taking 25% less damage. Damage to one feeds a counterattack from the other. Switch targets and interrupt the marked caster, or break its link with distance or cover: both take 25% more damage for 4 seconds. Neither becomes invulnerable. Defeated cores stay defeated; the survivor keeps its own short, wide or long, narrow barrage. Personal damage, shields and healing share each enemy’s contribution budget. No new skill or machinery interaction is required.
